about_the_game:
A confused creation awakens deep underground, exploring a strange and perilous world alone.

“Light Devourer” is a pixel-art, top-down ARPG featuring exhilarating combat, intricate world exploration, and a dark fantasy narrative.

Game Features

  • Unleash relentless attacks and dodge with quick dashes to avoid danger! Accumulate Dark Energy and unleash powerful Rage Bursts—combine your moves skillfully to defeat deadly foes!

  • Explore a vast, interconnected world—travel through the emerald crystal caverns, lush green forests, the grim thunder castle, and the void among the stars!

  • Absorb the light energy of fallen enemies to enhance your own attributes. Strengthen traits that benefit your weapon, and gain an overwhelming advantage in battle!

  • Equip powerful Emblems! Collect ancient emblems scattered throughout the world to gain unique abilities. Mix and match your favorites to suit your playstyle!

  • Enjoy breathtaking scenery and immersive music that bring unforgettable atmosphere to the world.

  • Never lose your way during exploration! Once you discover landmarks, you can view the map at any time to track your position and locate unexplored regions!

For whatever reason you’ve come to this world—
defeat all your enemies, and devour all the light.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS Monterey 12.3
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M1（7 Core GPU）or Intel Iris Plus Graphics 645
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any sound card compatible with Core Audio
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS Sonoma 14.0
  • Processor: Apple M2 or Apple M1 Pro
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M2（10 Core GPU）or M1 Pro（14 Core GPU）
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any sound card compatible with Core Audio
